title: Happy Mac
behavior: A smiling computer greeted people during a successful Macintosh startup.
lesson: A tiny face can make a system state feel welcoming.

title: Clarus the dogcow
behavior: A spotted dogcow demonstrated page orientation in print dialogs and answered with “Moof.”
lesson: Give a useful state preview a memorable character.

title: Clarus returns
behavior: macOS Ventura restored Clarus to the Page Setup orientation preview.
lesson: A restrained callback can connect redesigns across decades.

title: Snoopy watch face
behavior: Snoopy and Woodstock play with watch hands and react to weather and workouts.
lesson: Contextual reactions feel authored instead of random.

title: Toy Story watch faces
behavior: Woody, Jessie, and Buzz Lightyear come alive on Apple Watch faces.
lesson: Familiar characters can turn repeated glances into small encounters.

title: Genie minimization
behavior: A window visibly funnels toward its destination in the Dock.
lesson: Motion can explain where an object went.

title: Dashboard ripple and flip
behavior: Widgets arrived with a ripple and flipped over to reveal settings.
lesson: Keep an object’s spatial identity coherent across states.

title: Rubber-band scrolling
behavior: Content stretches past an edge and springs back when released.
lesson: Pleasant feedback can also explain a boundary.

title: Passbook shredder
behavior: Deleting a pass fed it through a miniature on-screen shredder.
lesson: An ending can feel satisfying while remaining unmistakable.

title: Home Screen jiggle
behavior: Apps and widgets jiggle together while the Home Screen is editable.
lesson: Shared motion can make a temporary mode obvious.

title: Aqua controls
behavior: Mac OS X introduced luminous, translucent controls with a gel-like surface.
lesson: Material character can invite use when readability stays intact.

title: Cover Flow albums
behavior: Album covers became glossy objects browsed like records in a bin.
lesson: A familiar material metaphor can make browsing more direct.

title: Leather Calendar
behavior: Calendar resembled a stitched leather desk book with torn paper details.
lesson: Texture creates atmosphere, but it should serve the task.

title: Newsstand shelves
behavior: Digital publications sat on a wood-grain bookshelf.
lesson: A container can make an unfamiliar collection instantly legible.

title: Liquid Glass
behavior: Translucent controls reflect, refract, and adapt to surrounding content and light.
lesson: A dynamic material still needs hierarchy and reliable contrast.

title: Working Clock icon
behavior: The Clock app icon shows the current time with a moving second hand.
lesson: Let a decorative surface carry live, useful information.

title: Working Calendar icon
behavior: The Calendar icon displays today’s weekday and date.
lesson: A familiar icon can quietly answer a common question.

title: Flashlight switch
behavior: The tiny switch inside the Flashlight control moves between off and on.
lesson: Mirror real state in the smallest available detail.

title: Maps icon landmarks
behavior: Successive Maps icons depict roads and landmarks around Apple’s Cupertino campuses.
lesson: Specific local detail can give a generic tool identity.

title: TestFlight development stages
behavior: TestFlight’s propeller blades depict app icons at different stages of construction.
lesson: An icon can explain a product’s role through its own construction.

title: Mac startup chord
behavior: A warm chord confirms that a Mac has begun a successful startup.
lesson: Use sound to reassure, not merely announce.

title: Sosumi alert
behavior: A system alert sound carried the mischievous name “Sosumi.”
lesson: Private wit works best when the cue remains clear.

title: Watch turn taps
behavior: Maps uses distinct tick-tock patterns for left and right turns, then vibrates on arrival.
lesson: Tactile patterns can communicate direction without demanding sight.

title: Keyboard haptics
behavior: The iPhone keyboard can provide a small sound or haptic response for each keypress.
lesson: Subtle feedback can make glass controls feel definite.

title: Apple Pencil Pro pulse
behavior: A light haptic pulse confirms a squeeze, double tap, or snap to shape.
lesson: Confirm invisible mode changes at the point of action.

title: Macintosh Puzzle
behavior: A compact sliding-tile game shipped as a Macintosh desk accessory.
lesson: Play can belong in a tool when its resource cost stays modest.

title: Desktop pattern editor
behavior: People could draw an 8-by-8 pixel pattern and tile it across the desktop.
lesson: Small creative tools can make a shared environment feel personal.

title: Photo Booth effects
behavior: Built-in camera effects invited people to experiment with the new iMac camera.
lesson: Introduce capability through a safe, enjoyable trial.

title: Kaleidoscope watch face
behavior: A watch face turns chosen static images into shifting kaleidoscopic patterns.
lesson: A simple input can support many playful outcomes.

title: Activity celebrations
behavior: Apple Watch presents visual celebrations when everyday activity achievements are earned.
lesson: Reserve spectacle for a clear, earned milestone.

title: Messages celebrations
behavior: Balloons, confetti, and fireworks can take over the screen for a message.
lesson: Match expressive intensity to deliberate user intent.

title: Invisible Ink
behavior: A message stays obscured until its recipient swipes across it.
lesson: A reveal can carry tone while preserving recipient control.

title: Handwritten messages
behavior: Messages can send handwriting as a personal animated note.
lesson: Preserve traces of the person when polish would erase them.

title: Memoji
behavior: A custom avatar can mirror a person’s voice and facial expressions.
lesson: Offer expressive tools as editable choices, not fixed identities.

title: FaceTime reactions
behavior: Gestures can trigger hearts, balloons, fireworks, lasers, or rain during calls.
lesson: Give live expression a clear trigger and social context.

title: Dynamic Desktop
behavior: Mojave’s desert desktop shifts its lighting from dawn through evening.
lesson: A quiet environment can acknowledge time without interruption.

title: Animated Weather scenes
behavior: Weather backgrounds animate sun position, clouds, and precipitation for current conditions.
lesson: Ambient motion can explain live data when it stays calm.

title: Astronomy watch face
behavior: A continuously updated 3D Earth, Moon, or solar system can move through time with the crown.
lesson: Make a data model explorable at the scale of its display.

title: Solar Analog
behavior: A luminous watch dial changes light and shadow with the Sun’s daily position.
lesson: Let environmental data shape atmosphere as well as labels.

title: Macintosh landscape
behavior: macOS Sequoia turns classic Macintosh iconography into an animated screen landscape.
lesson: Historical fragments can become a coherent new setting.

title: Apple I bare board
behavior: Apple’s first computer presented its construction as a bare circuit board rather than a finished appliance.
lesson: An honest construction can become a product’s identity.

title: Rainbow Apple
behavior: Six colored stripes made the bitten-apple silhouette approachable and advertised color capability.
lesson: A simple mark can carry both warmth and product meaning.

title: Colorful translucent iMac
behavior: The iMac wrapped computer parts in curved translucent shells offered in vivid colors and patterns.
lesson: Let personal choice extend to the whole physical object.

title: iPod Socks
behavior: Six knitted sleeves protected an iPod while giving it a changeable wardrobe.
lesson: A useful accessory can carry low-stakes personality.

title: Anodized iPod mini
behavior: The aluminum iPod mini arrived in silver, gold, pink, blue, and green.
lesson: Color can make a technical object feel personally chosen.

title: Color-coordinated iMac
behavior: The iMac’s keyboard, mouse, trackpad, cable, and interface accents coordinate with its chosen color.
lesson: Carry identity through the complete product family.

title: Macintosh case signatures
behavior: The original Macintosh team’s signatures were molded inside the computer case.
lesson: Optional discovery can reward long-term affection without interrupting use.

title: Named About boxes
behavior: Early Mac applications could name their author in the About box and window title.
lesson: Visible credit can connect a polished tool to its makers.

title: Swedish campground Command key
behavior: Susan Kare adapted a Swedish attraction symbol into the Mac’s 16-pixel Command glyph.
lesson: A borrowed symbol gains meaning through consistent, careful use.

title: Designed by Apple in California
behavior: Apple published a 450-photo design archive on custom paper with gilded matte-silver edges.
lesson: Treat a record of the work as a designed object too.

title: Calendar’s July 17
behavior: The original fixed iCal date commemorated its introduction; the 17 remains in Apple calendar emoji.
lesson: A date can preserve product history without adding interface chrome.
